p_hat.notes: Decomp is a stub: only collision templates exist (propeller spike cyl Atp 1 = quarter heart, radii 15 are init placeholders resized at runtime). Function names give the state machine: fly -> spin-propeller (puropera_kaiten) -> hit by sword/wind blows propeller off (bunri) -> body falls (fujyou/hane) -> damage_dead; wind (Deku Leaf) and water moves; sea version is the Seahat. Numbers unknown. radius was 15.0: that is the static collision TEMPLATE placeholder, which the actor's own create() resizes at runtime - and every one of those bodies is /* Nonmatching */ in the decomp, so the real value is not recoverable. 15 would give an absurd hitbox; null falls through to the engine's 40 default. Cleared 2026-08-22.
